components.name: base_ang_vel

components.notes: base body COM linear velocity (m/s), body frame; append-only v2 field

components.notes: sin/cos of lifecycle-relative gait oscillator; append-only v3 field

components.notes: binary current contact in controller.foot_contact_bodies order; append-only v4 field

components.name: start_mode
